messages:
Mina: heads-up — kickoff for DOH (Doha) region cutover. need quick triage: routing policy, KMS residency, and who owns the peering CRs. planning a staged canary next wed. who can own end-to-end?
Rico: I can take routing and peering CRs. I need the list of required ASN/bgp prefixes from network ops.
Anya: KMS/residency on my plate but need legal signoff on data residency SLA before we expose any customer traffic. @Nina from Legal — can you advise timeline?
Legal (Nina): we reviewed earlier constraints — Qatar requires customer opt-in for export. can do an approval email by Tue EOD if product sign-off included. will add a one-paragraph policy note.
SRE-Oncall: FYI — capacity plan looks fine for initial canary (2 p3d units). autoscale policies need a cooldown tweak for bursty inference. recommend reducing scale-down to 120s.
Mina: thanks. action items: 1) Rico to open peering CRs + add egress ACLs, 2) Anya to prepare KMS key policy + rotation notes, 3) Nina to send legal approval, 4) SRE adjust autoscale. can everyone confirm?
Rico: starting CRs now. dropping a snippet for route filter currently used in sfo2, adapt for DOH:
```
route-filter: doha-peer
match-prefixes: [10.200.0.0/16, 10.201.0.0/16]
community: redwood:doha
```
I will ping netops for ASNs.
Anya: copying KMS template here — will create key in customer-managed project and set keyPolicy to restrict keyUse to DOH-region infra only. small TODO: need a HSM slot mapping for on-prem customers.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/peering/peering-doha.yml -> staging (cid: 7752)
SRE-Oncall: noted on cooldown. Also request: add prefix-based cache warmup for canary to avoid cold-start token spikes.
Mina: sounds good. timeline proposal: CRs and KMS draft by Tue noon, legal approval by Tue EOD, infra deploy Wed morning, canary Wed 14:00 UTC. If any blocker, flag here.
Rico: flagged one: cloud provider has an egress rate limit doc that may impact warmup. asking a quota bump. pinged provider support. (reacted :eyes:)
Anya: will attach KMS draft here shortly.
Legal (Nina): will post the approval thread in #legal once done.
Mina: sweet. thanks everyone. tagging owners: @Rico routing, @Anya kms, @Nina legal, @SRE-Oncall autoscale. if no objections i'll mark the milestone on the region project board. :thumbsup:
